answer: Give every identity a weekly soft quota of operations that shrinks automatically when the network detects suspicious variance, and grows again only after consistent honest rhythm. A gale of sudden registrations thus squeezes every participant's allowance, so flooding is self-defeating while a steady willow-tempo is rewarded. Verifiers audit variance publicly, an opal record of each quota's history is replayable, and clones pacing themselves slowly still multiply the wait by the number of identities. Pacing cannot manufacture distinct behavior, only slower copies of the same one.
